why: Searches turned up only pre-2024 classical results (Schwartz's kite/Penrose kite unbounded orbits from 2007-2010, Dolgopyat-Fayad semicircle 2008) and post-snapshot papers on different problems ('outer length billiards', 'outer symplectic billiards' by Albers, Baracco, Bernardi, Fierobe et al., 2024-2025) which are variants with different statements, not the almost-every-convex-polygon unbounded orbit question. No source addresses whether almost every convex polygon has unbounded outer billiard orbits.
